note: Working titles from the brief. Each is a hypothesis to test, not evidence of popularity, search volume, or product quality. Guides contain questions and checks only. They make no performance claim about any product.

guides.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
guides.summary: Two common shapes answer different kitchens. Start with how you plan to cook before you compare models.
questions: Do you mostly cook one tray of food at a time, or several things at once?
Do you need to bake or roast whole items, or mostly fry?
How much counter space is free, and how tall can the appliance be?
listing_checks: Does the title say 'Dual Basket' or 'Double Basket'? Observed here: the P1 title describes two independent baskets.
Does the title describe an oven, toaster oven, or 'French Door' design? Observed here: the P2 title describes a French door multi-function air fryer toaster oven.
Does the title list functions beyond frying? Observed here: the P3 title lists Bake, Dehydrate, and Frozen functions.

guides.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
guides.summary: Capacity is easy to misread. Compare the numbers the listing states, and check what they mean for your food.
questions: How many people will you usually cook for?
What size of food do you cook most often?
Does the listing give capacity per basket or for the whole unit?
listing_checks: Capacity in quarts appears in the titles here: '6 Quart' (P1), '26QT' (P2), and '8 Qt' (P3).
Check the product details section for the stated capacity and basket dimensions before comparing titles.
A two-basket title (P1) may list capacity per basket. Confirm this in the listing details.

guides.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
guides.summary: Cleaning and storage often decide whether a small appliance gets used. Check them before you buy.
questions: Which parts will you wash after each use, and how often?
Do you have a sink or dishwasher close to the appliance?
Where will the appliance live between uses?
listing_checks: Check whether the listing says the baskets or trays are dishwasher-safe. Observed here: the P1 title says 'Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets' and the P3 title says 'Dishwasher-Safe Basket'.
Check the stated dimensions and weight in the product details section.
Look for accessories that add parts to clean. Observed here: the P2 title says 'Six Cooking Accessories Included'.

guides.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
guides.summary: Many functions can mean more to learn and more parts to store. Decide which functions you will use before you compare.
questions: Which two or three functions would you use every week?
Would you use a preset, or set time and temperature yourself?
What would you stop using first if the appliance had fewer parts?
listing_checks: Count the preset options as stated in the title. Observed here: the P2 title states '24 One-Touch Preset Options'.
Check which functions the title names. Observed here: P3 names 'TurboFry 4-in-1' and lists Bake, Dehydrate, and Frozen.
Check whether the listing states a temperature range. Confirm it in the product details.
